title: Answer
description:
The copies of the heavenly things were purified with the blood of that service. The heavenly things themselves required a better sacrifice. That necessity is real.

Entering every year with the blood of another shows the work was not finished. He offered Himself once.

It is appointed to men to die once, and after that the judgment. That appointment reads His one offering as bearing the sins of many, not as a rite to be repeated.

He will appear a second time, apart from sin, for salvation. After the one offering, the appearing is still to come.
